allow:
PowerShell($dir = Join-Path $HOME ".gabs\bannerlord"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null
$bridgePath = Join-Path $dir "bridge.json"
$runtimePath = Join-Path $dir "runtime.json"
$content = '{"port": 4825, "token": "80c93be27f02d35bedbe46493ce7a12f3d9976cc195cce2ece727cfdd0f09f9d", "gameId": "bannerlord"}'
Set-Content -Path $bridgePath -Value $content -NoNewline
Remove-Item $runtimePath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Host "GABS files ready")

hooks.command: bash -c 'state=$(curl -sfG --max-time 1 --data-urlencode "path=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" http://localhost:7777/state 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; if echo "$state" | grep -q "\"isPaused\":true"; then echo "[JBDebugBridge] Debugger is paused — handle exception before sending game commands:"; echo "$state"; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'S="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/session-start.sh"; if [ "$(uname -s)" = Linux ]; then exec "$S"; elif command -v wsl.exe >/dev/null 2>&1; then case "$S" in /mnt/[a-zA-Z]/*) W="$S";; /[a-zA-Z]/*) DRIVE=$(echo "${S:1:1}" | tr A-Z a-z); W="/mnt/${DRIVE}${S:2}";; *) W=$(MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl.exe wslpath -u "$S" 2>/dev/null | tr -d "\r");; esac; [ -n "$W" ] && MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl.exe bash "$W"; fi'
